title: Qt: Allow to select specific default profile
description:
Allows for the user to select / choose a profile which
will always be loaded after starting the application,
therefore overriding the current default behaviour of
always loading the last loaded one. Additionally it will
also allow to always load the default profile instead
of the last selected one.

AI-Assisted: no

Fixes: https://gitlab.com/wireshark/wireshark/-/work_items/21421

unapproved this merge request
Please do not merge yet. It has at least two regression issues.
Which ones? I tried it with a bunch of profiles and handling here, it worked for me?

I’m traveling so I can only read the diff right now.
* Move between 4.6 and 4.7/5.0 will fail because of a unneeded pref name change. Keep the name.
* Last used profile name not always stored. When the new pref is changed the last used profile name is out-of-sync.
* Is the new pref added to capture page? This is nothing related to capture.
* No commit message ref til the reported issue.

No, there is specific functionality in there to move the setting if the original setting is used. And it makes absolute sense to clean up the names when we switch between major versions. Makes it way easier to correlate settings. Now, changing back from 5.x to 4.x will not work, but so won't a lot of issues.

When the new pref is changed the change is stored. I tried a couple of different ways to do it and it was always stored properly. Can you demonstrate a specific method or way where this happens?

It is in the capture section, because it fits nowhere else and the settings as well as functionality of profiles is very much affecting capture. If you have a better idea where to put them, please let me know. 

I'll update the commit message, I was simply only going off the discord communication and overlooked that there was an issue already

Please do not break switching between versions worse than it is, that is just annoying. The argument that you did this before is not good.

Turn on the new feature. Change profile. Turn off the new feature. Close Wireshark. Now I think the old profile name is stored, not the new. But I cannot verify right now.

We need a different place than capture prefs, that is wrong. I wanted to discuss this details before anyone made a hasty implementation.

First of, I hard disagree on the naming but I am not fighting that battle. I think the name is something only we see and it took me a while figuring out which preferences belong together which is the whole reason we have naming and therefore cleaning up a few names when iterating major versions just is the right thing to do. 

"Turn on the new feature. Change profile. Turn off the new feature. Close Wireshark. Now I think the old profile name is stored, not the new. But I cannot verify right now." - again, I disagree that we should support this. TBH, this is exactly what I meant with being too overprotective with the user. If you play around with settings, we should not be the ones protecting you. If you turn on the feature, change the profile, turn off the feature AND NOW only close the preference dialog, nothing will have changed as we only store preferences on closing the window. But if the user changes the settings / profiles AND closed the preference settings, the assumption is that the user has messed around with settings. There should be no assumptions that we will restore any older setting. We dont even have the indication that that is what the user intends to have. By arbitrary changing back to the old setting we will actively work against what he is doing and that might lead to even weirder consequences for him.

I am all ears where to put it, really don't mind putting it anywhere else, but it should be at least in a place that is somewhat correlated to capturing / displaying packets. It has nothing to do with Layout/arrangement/Display, ... And the rest of the config options is even less suited. Creating a section JUST for profiles does not make sense and adding this to the profile manager makes it hard to change settings as the user would have to go to a couple of places. But as I said, I am not against moving it, it just should make sense.

Btw, my argument for changing the preference name is not that I or we did that before. My argument is, that users should NEVER expect downwards compatibility across major versions. If that is the case, we should have a serious discussion because that will hinder us effectively to do anything new or update features and just can only add features. If the expectation is moving from 4.6 to 5.x and then back down to 4.6 again will not have repercussions than I strongly disagree. Because that would run major versions obsolete and we should move to a continuous versioning model
Maybe move the preference to the appearance panel? After all a profile also impacts the appearance.

Yes I think the appearance panel is the best place.

Selecting a profile should be a drop-down menu like we have in the copy-from-profile buttons. This to simplify the selection and avoid unwanted profile name typos, uppercase/lowercase issues, etc.

Changing the stored recent name `gui.last_used_profile` does not have any technical argument here, just your personal preference. Nothing is improved or fixed with a rename, it just makes a regression issue for users using both a stable and a development version (which is not only core developers). No need to argue about this.

Change this to always set gui_profile_name will fix the issue.

This can be simplified to `set_profile_name(recent.gui_profile_name)` because NULL is handled as Default.

It can, but that is implicit behaviour (which we rely on anyway when the profile name no longer exists). I'd rather have the explicit handling as it makes it easier to understand the code at a later point.

commits_data.message:
Qt: Allow to select specific default profile

Allows for the user to select / choose a profile which
will always be loaded after starting the application,
therefore overriding the current default behaviour of
always loading the last loaded one. Additionally it will
also allow to always load the default profile instead
of the last selected one.

Fixes #21421
